'''Pensar Luc''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who was appointed [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] just after the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. Reform-minded, he was committed to clearing up [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and removing corruption in the [[Axxila antipirate fleet]]. Luc hand-picked trustworthy officers from the antipirate fleet, including veterans of the [[Ciutric Planetary Security Forces]], to staff a new task force in the Hegemony, which provided a major boost to the early career of [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]].<ref name="EGtW" />
